description: Every line of pre text that overflows gets the ellipsis.

florui.text:
The quick brown fox
jumps over
the lazy dog and more
florui.css: .p { width: 90px; overflow: hidden; white-space: pre; text-overflow: ellipsis; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 14.42% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 20.70% and the box is the same size, so it fails.
